system.description:
At Level 2 you unlock tier 1 spells in the schools you know and gain a mana pool. Your mana pool is equal to (INT×3) + LVL and recharges on a Safe Rest.

You unlock a new spell tier every even level, and may upcast spells at each unlocked tier:

  • Tier 1 — Level 2

  • Tier 2 — Level 4

  • Tier 3 — Level 6

  • Tier 4 — Level 8

  • Tier 5 — Level 10

  • Tier 6 — Level 12

  • Tier 7 — Level 14

  • Tier 8 — Level 16

  • Tier 9 — Level 18

[M] Grants Blue's Codex spells from your known Book of Ruin schools (chosen via Dark Knowledge) up to your unlocked tier. Spell grants and the mana pool formula are wired by the module — see the GM notes on this feature.
